_comment: Pinned external tools for the hotfix benchmark. Get-BenchmarkTools.ps1 downloads these and refuses to continue on a SHA256 mismatch. Pinning the version and hash here, rather than committing the binaries, keeps the repo small and makes every result traceable to an exact tool build.

cfr.note: Java decompiler used for the static hotfix analysis in docs/adobe-hotfixes/1-first-hotfix-static-analysis.md. Runs on a plain JRE.

asm.note: ObjectWeb ASM core, used by scripts/java/PatchHotfix.java to surgically edit one method in the Adobe hotfix jar. SHA1 of both ASM jars was cross-checked against Maven Central's published .sha1 siblings.

asm-tree.note: ObjectWeb ASM Tree API (depends on asm), used by scripts/java/PatchHotfix.java.

oha.note: Optional fixed-rate latency check with coordinated-omission correction. Install separately with 'winget install hatoo.oha' (Windows) or 'cargo install oha'. Not downloaded by Get-BenchmarkTools.ps1 because oha ships as an installer rather than a bare binary.
